newsitem.title: THAILAND: Scan taps $46 mln, 2-yr foreign loan.
newsitem.headline: Scan taps $46 mln, 2-yr foreign loan.

text.p: Thailand's Scandinavian Leasing Plc said on Monday it has tapped a $46 million, two-year, foreign loan to be used for retiring the current costly short-term loans and for business expansion.

Scandinavian Leasing said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the new loan, with a prepayment option for the borrower after the first year, carries an annual interest rate of 0.875 percent above LIBOR.
It said 60 percent of the loan from Citicorp Investment (Singapore) Bank and Commerce Bank (Asia) Ltd was covered by a currency swap to protect the company against foreign exchange risk.
